info.name: Get all users in your organization

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields you want to fetch for each user. If used, only the specified fields will be included in the response.

items.docs:
This route allows you to fetch all of the users in your Port organization.

To learn more about users, check out the [documentation](https://docs.port.io/sso-rbac/rbac-overview/).

info.name: Invite a user to your organization

params.name: notify
params.description: If `true`, the invitee will receive an email notification.

items.docs:

To learn more about users, roles, and teams, check out the [documentation](https://docs.port.io/sso-rbac/rbac-overview/).
